lines.en: label nikispring3:
scene sky
That funny feeling starts to fade halfway through the bus ride. Something else died near the side of the road.
lines.zh: 那种奇怪的感觉在公交车程过半时开始消退。路边又有什么东西死了。

lines.en: Its guts were left out on display for the few of us who stayed for breakfast, making the meal less than worth it and one more batch of intestines away from being emptied out into one of the aisles.
lines.zh: 它的内脏就那么摊在那儿，供我们这几个留下来吃早饭的人观赏，让这顿饭吃得一点也不值，只差再多一副肠子，就有人要吐在某条过道上了。

lines.en: The sun is bright, at least. It kind of has to be. It’s made of fire. Did you know that?
lines.zh: 至少太阳很亮。它也只能亮。它是火做的。你知道吗？

lines.en: Anyway, yeah. Dead bodies and bus rides. That’s been the morning so far. That and the casual admittance of sex with two parties sometime during a party without sex.
lines.zh: 总之，是的。尸体和公交车。这就是到目前为止的早晨。还有随口承认的一句：在一场没有性的派对上，跟两方发生过性关系。

lines.en: If that doesn’t make sense, it’s because it doesn’t make sense. And nothing ever makes sense. But we keep on trucking anyway because people are a lot like truck drivers.
lines.zh: 如果这听起来不通，那是因为它本来就不通。从来就没有什么说得通的东西。可我们还是在继续跑车，因为人跟卡车司机很像。

lines.en: Moving from one place to the next. Urinating in plastic jugs because we’re too lazy or busy to pull off to the side of the room. And sometimes you miss. Sometimes you become the pee boy.
lines.zh: 从一个地方挪到下一个地方。尿在塑料壶里，因为我们懒得、或者忙得没法靠到房间边上去。有时候你会洒出来。有时候你就成了那个尿裤子的小子。

lines.en: But the fact of the matter is that facts don’t matter, matter does. And since we all have to share it, we might as well figure out the best ways.
lines.zh: 但事情的真相是：所谓事实并不重要，物质才重要。既然我们都得分摊这份物质，那不如找出最好的分摊方式。

lines.en: So I unfold a piece of paper I found in my pocket this morning. I don’t know how it got there, nor do I understand the words written in red ink across it. But it reads, “see me in the spring time.”
lines.zh: 于是我展开今早在口袋里摸到的一张纸。我不知道它是怎么进去的，也不明白上面用红墨水写的字是什么意思。但那上面写着：「春天的时候来见我。」

lines.en: Does this mean it was written in one of the better seasons?
lines.zh: 这是说，它是在某个比较好的季节里写下的吗？

lines.en: Are there any seasons better than this?
lines.zh: 还有什么季节比这个更好吗？

lines.en: Or does the writer only write what needs to be written, for that is the right thing to do?
lines.zh: 还是说，写字的人只写该写的东西，因为那才是正确的事？

lines.en: I don’t have an answer for you. And I don’t have a solution for me.
lines.zh: 我没有答案给你。也没有解药给我自己。

lines.en: scene black
But the bus pulls up to where it’s meant to drop me off and I leave, passing a girl waiting outside holding a briefcase on my way out.
lines.zh: 不过公交车还是停在了该放我下车的地方，我下了车，出门时经过一个拎着公文包在外头等车的女孩。

lines.en: I wonder where she’s going. Why she looks so familiar. Which row she sits in when she gets on the bus. But it’s on the opposite side of the street, and I never get to see.
lines.zh: 我想知道她要去哪儿。为什么她看着这么眼熟。上车后她会坐哪一排。可车站在街对面，我终究没能看到。

lines.en: I roll up my sleeves, then roll them back down as I want to look cool but always hate the sensation of something gripping me a little too tightly. And sleeves are like children you can never get rid of.
lines.zh: 我把袖子卷起来，又放下去——我想显得酷一点，可又一直讨厌有什么东西把我箍得太紧的感觉。而袖子就像孩子，你永远摆脱不掉。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom1
I prepare myself to open the door. To see those shadows in suspicious places that never quite match the light. And I wonder to myself if I really am inside of a video game.
lines.zh: 我做好准备去推开那扇门。去看见那些出现在可疑位置的、跟光线怎么都对不上的影子。我暗自琢磨，我是不是真的活在一款电子游戏里。

lines.en: To some extent, I probably am. But to some extent, I’m probably not. My feelings are feelings. My dreams are dreams. So does it really make a difference the amount of pixels and promises I can fit in one hand?
lines.zh: 在某种程度上，大概是。可在某种程度上，大概不是。我的感觉就是感觉。我的梦就是梦。那么，我一只手能攥下多少像素和承诺，真的有区别吗？

lines.en: I ask you this question as a man about to give a part of himself away. Or one who attempts to create another part so that he can continue to exist in the presence of someone kind.
lines.zh: 我问你这个问题的时候，我是一个正准备把自己一部分交出去的男人。或者说，是一个试图再创造出另一部分、好让自己能继续存在于某个温柔的人身边的男人。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom2
: Ami? I’m home.
lines.zh: : Ami？我回来了。

lines.en: : Dad!
lines.zh: : 爸爸！

lines.en: scene livingintheroom3
: Welcome back! We were just talking about you!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来！我们刚才还在说你呢！

lines.en: Two girls with the seasons in their hair — one just right while the other’s cut short. But every day it grows some more. And both are bright. Both are beautiful.
lines.zh: 两个把四季别在头发上的女孩——一个长度刚好，另一个剪得短短的。可它每天都在长长一点。两个都明艳。两个都好看。

lines.en: They look like a pair. The kind that comes shrink-wrapped.
lines.zh: 她们看着像一对。那种用收缩膜包装好一起卖的一对。

lines.en: : How was your trip? Did you have fun?
lines.zh: : 旅行怎么样？玩得开心吗？

lines.en: scene livingintheroom4
I struggle to speak, for it feels like I’ve stepped out of my world and into another. One where I never made mistakes and never cut my hand.
lines.zh: 我艰难地开口，因为感觉自己像是走出了自己的世界，踏进了另一个。在那个世界里，我从来没犯过错，也从来没割伤过手。

lines.en: But if I never cut my hand, I’d have never cut my knee. And if I never cut my knee, I’d have never felt the touch of the departed as it lingers on my softskin. That untimely desperation. The cancer it became.
lines.zh: 可如果我没割伤手，就不会割伤膝盖。如果没割伤膝盖，就不会感受到逝者的触碰，久久停留在我的软肤上。那份不合时宜的绝望。以及它后来变成的癌。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: It was fun.
lines.zh: : 挺开心的。

lines.en: : That’s great! We had lots of fun too. Niki even brought one of her old costumes for me to try on! But I don’t want to talk about why it didn’t fit.
lines.zh: : 太好了！我们也玩得很开心。Niki 还带了她以前的一件演出服来给我试穿呢！不过我不想聊它为什么穿不下。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom5
: Maybe one day, Ami. Not everyone can be born gifted.
lines.zh: : 也许有一天吧，Ami。不是谁都能天生就有本钱的。

lines.en: : I’ll show all of you one day. Mark my words. I’m just one of those “late bloomer” types.
lines.zh: : 总有一天我会让你们所有人见识到的。记住我的话。我只是那种「大器晚成」的类型。

lines.en: : So apart from your boobs basically not existing, how did it feel wearing the costume? It didn’t light some sort of spark that will propel you to become the next top idol, did it?
lines.zh: : 那么，除了你那基本不存在的胸之外，穿上那件演出服感觉怎么样？它没点燃什么火花、推着你成为下一个顶级偶像吧？

lines.en: scene livingintheroom6
: Me? An idol? I wish. I barely pass as a maid.
lines.zh: : 我？当偶像？我也想啊。我连当女仆都勉强。

lines.en: : I say you should go for it. It’d be fun tormenting your dad by having both of his favorite girls wind up as super popular, super famous idols who could get anyone they want but wind up with him.
lines.zh: : 我说你就去试试吧。想想看，他最疼的两个姑娘都成了超级人气、超级有名的偶像，想要谁就能得到谁，最后却都跟了他——用这个来折磨你爸爸，肯定很有意思。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if “torment” is really the right word there. I’m really proud of you, Niki. And Ami...well, I’m also proud of you. Just in a different way.
lines.zh: : 我不确定「折磨」这个词用得对不对。我真的很为你骄傲，Niki。还有 Ami……嗯，我也为你骄傲。只是方式不太一样。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom7
: I’m sure you are proud. But the truthier truth is that you’re totally jealous that there are a trillion other guys and girls thinking impure things about me every day.
lines.zh: : 我相信你骄傲。但更真实的真相是，你嫉妒得要死——每天都有无数男人女人在对我动歪念头。

lines.en: : Now, imagine they were doing that same thing about Ami.
lines.zh: : 现在，想象一下他们对 Ami 也做同样的事。

lines.en: : I would kill them.
lines.zh: : 我会杀了他们。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom8
: I rest my case.
lines.zh: : 我没什么好说的了。

lines.en: : Yay! Murder!
lines.zh: : 好耶！杀人！

lines.en: : But in a context that doesn’t make me look like the bad guy!
lines.zh: : 但得是在不会让我显得像坏人的前提下！

lines.en: scene black
I drop what little luggage I have off in my room before coming back out to have the girls fill me in on their weekend alone together.
lines.zh: 我把那点可怜的行李放回房间，再出来听两个姑娘讲她们单独相处的这个周末。

lines.en: All things considered, this was a bit of a trial run. And that was the exact intention I had in mind when I asked Niki to do it.
lines.zh: 总的来说，这算是一次试运行。而这正是我让 Niki 来做这件事时心里的打算。

lines.en: But I guess I must have been a little pessimistic as I didn’t expect her to agree so readily.
lines.zh: 不过我大概有点悲观过头了，因为我没想到她答应得这么爽快。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom9
She’s serious about this “moving in” thing. The matching pajamas were the straw that blew the camel’s back out or however that one phrase goes.
lines.zh: 她对「搬进来」这件事是认真的。那套亲子睡衣就是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草——那句话大概就是这么说的。

lines.en: But there’s a glaring problem with them — as they have overthrown that downtrodden, unkempt look from our tour down memory lane that I previously crowned as the most attractive she’s ever been.
lines.zh: 可它们有个刺眼的问题——它们一举推翻了我们那趟记忆之旅里，她那副落魄凌乱的模样，而我之前可是把那模样封为她最有魅力的时刻。

lines.en: In this moment, I want her more than ever before. And I’m sure that was calculated on her behalf as I now have no desire to back out from something that may very well change my life.
lines.zh: 这一刻，我比以往任何时候都更想要她。而我敢肯定这是她算计好的——因为现在，我对这件很可能改变我一生的事，已经毫无退缩之心了。

lines.en: : Coffee? Ami taught me how to make it the way you like.
lines.zh: : 咖啡？Ami 教过我怎么冲你喜欢的那种。

lines.en: : You guys are looking a little close there, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你们俩靠得有点近吧？

lines.en: scene livingintheroom10
: Got a problem with that, loser? Akira and I aren’t blood-related. That means I’m allowed to get all close to him.
lines.zh: : 有意见吗，输家？我和 Akira 又没有血缘关系。那我就可以跟他贴多近都行。

lines.en: : Those laws will change one day! I just have to wait for Nodoka to become the prime minister, I think. Unhand my father!
lines.zh: : 那些法律总有一天会改的！我只要等 Nodoka 当上首相就行了，我想。放开我爸爸！

lines.en: : Nnnnnnnnnno! Phbhhbhht!
: Dad! Tell Niki to-
lines.zh: : 爸爸！你让 Niki——

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: scene livingintheroom11
: How would you feel if Niki moved in with us?
lines.zh: : 如果 Niki 搬来跟我们一起住，你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : You’re sure you want to do this now? You don’t want coffee first?
lines.zh: : 你确定现在就要谈这个？你不想先喝杯咖啡？

lines.en: : Yeah, you should probably have some coffee first. You’re clearly super-tired since that made like zero sense to me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你大概该先喝点咖啡。你显然是累坏了，因为那句话对我来说完全不通。

lines.en: : What part of it didn’t make sense?
lines.zh: : 哪一部分不通？

lines.en: scene livingintheroom12
: The part where you’re inviting a famous idol to come live in our tiny house that barely fits the two of us when it’s always been just you and me. Go on, have some coffee.
lines.zh: : 就是你邀请一位当红偶像来住我们这个小得只勉强塞得下我们俩的屋子——而且一直都只有你和我。来吧，喝点咖啡。

lines.en: : Why don’t...I just go and brew that now? I’ll give you two a second.
lines.zh: : 要不……我现在就去煮吧？给你们俩一点空间。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom13
: So you’re against it?
lines.zh: : 所以你反对？

lines.en: : Against what? Was that not just one of those hypothetical thingies?
lines.zh: : 反对什么？那不是个假设性的问题吗？

lines.en: : No, it wasn’t. In fact, this is something I’ve been wanting to talk to you about for a while now.
lines.zh: : 不，不是。事实上，这是我一直想跟你谈的事，已经想了挺久了。

lines.en: : Dad, come on. You can’t just invite Niki into our house like this without even asking her first! She’s one of the busiest people in the whole city.
lines.zh: : 爸爸，别闹了。你不能连问都没问过她，就这么把 Niki 请进我们家！她可是全城最忙的人之一。

lines.en: : And if word got out that she was living with her childhood friend, it could ruin her career! You’ve really gotta think these things through before just blurting them out like that, silly.
lines.zh: : 而且要是传出她跟青梅竹马同居的消息，会毁了她的事业！你真的得把事情想清楚再脱口而出啊，傻瓜。

lines.en: : Umm...if I may interject-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我能插一句吗——

lines.en: scene livingintheroom14
: This was actually...my idea.
lines.zh: : 这其实是……我的主意。

lines.en: : Niki, I’ve got this. But thank you.
lines.zh: : Niki，这个我来。不过谢谢你。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom13
: Okay. Back to coffee. I’ve never used this Kalita Wave thing before, though, so be prepared for potential failure.
lines.zh: : 好。回到咖啡。不过这个 Kalita Wave 的东西我从没用过，所以做好失败的准备吧。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom15
: Now I’m even more confused. Why would this be Niki’s idea?
lines.zh: : 现在我更糊涂了。这怎么会是 Niki 的主意？

lines.en: : Like, I get that she loves you and stuff. And that’s fine. But wouldn’t moving in together be a little too serious? Only families are supposed to live together, not friends.
lines.zh: : 就是说，她爱你之类的，我懂。这没问题。可是住在一起是不是太认真了点？只有一家人才该住在一起，朋友不该吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s what I’m trying to say. That’s why Niki wants to move in.
lines.zh: : 对，我要说的就是这个。所以 Niki 才想搬进来。

lines.en: : Are you guys actually related or something? Because that would be a crazy plot twist.
lines.zh: : 你们俩该不会真有血缘关系吧？那这剧情可就够炸裂的了。

lines.en: : Ami, no. We-
lines.zh: : Ami，不是。我们——

lines.en: scene livingintheroom16
: Ooooooh! It’s because she made me an honorary Nakayama sister. I get it now. She has been saying I’m like family a lot lately, so that tracks. And it’s really sweet, but no thanks.
lines.zh: : 哦——！是因为她认了我当中山家的荣誉姐妹。我懂了。她最近老说我就跟家人一样，那就对上了。这确实很暖，不过还是算了。

lines.en: : Just listen to me, okay? Niki is-
lines.zh: : 你听我说完，好吗？Niki 是——

lines.en: scene livingintheroom17
: Now an active participant in this conversation. I used the normal coffee brewer. It should be done in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 现在是这场对话的积极参与者了。我用的是普通咖啡机。再过几分钟就好了。

lines.en: : Niki, I can handle this.
lines.zh: : Niki，这个我能处理。

lines.en: : I’m sure you can, babe. But I think it’s best if I speak for myself here so Ami doesn’t keep misunderstanding everything.
lines.zh: : 我相信你能，宝贝。但我觉得这里最好还是由我自己来说，免得 Ami 一直误会下去。

lines.en: : Babe? I don’t like that. Call him Sensei or something. Even “Dad” is fine since we’re technically sisters, right?
lines.zh: : 宝贝？我不喜欢。叫他 Sensei 什么的。既然我们名义上是姐妹，叫「爸爸」也行吧？

lines.en: : Ami, didn’t you have fun this weekend? Wasn’t it nice having an older girl around here for once?
lines.zh: : Ami，这个周末你玩得不开心吗？家里头一回有个比你大的女孩陪着，不是挺好的吗？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. It was a lot of fun. I really liked spending time with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。很开心。我真的很喜欢跟你待在一起。

lines.en: : And I really liked spending time with you. So wouldn’t it be nice if that’s just how things were from now on?
lines.zh: : 我也真的很喜欢跟你待在一起。所以，如果从今往后一直都是这样，不是很好吗？

lines.en: : Like yeah, I’ve got a busy schedule now. But I’m also nearly thirty years old and the chances of my career lasting more than a few more years are pretty slim, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 没错，我现在档期很满。可我也快三十了，我的事业还能撑过几年的概率相当渺茫，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : After that, I’ll be free to coast off of residuals and convention signings for the rest of my life. I’ll have practically all the time in the world. And I want to spend as much of that time as I can with you.
lines.zh: : 在那之后，我就能靠版税和漫展签售悠哉地过完后半辈子了。我几乎会拥有全世界所有的时间。而我想把这些时间尽可能多地花在你身上。

lines.en: : Niki, with all due respect, that last part sounds like something a mom would say. So why not just reword that part and-
lines.zh: : Niki，恕我直言，最后那句听着像妈妈说的话。要不你换个说法——

lines.en: : Ami, you’re not getting it. That’s exactly what I want.
lines.zh: : Ami，你没听懂。我要的正是这个。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom18
: No, I’m not getting it. That doesn’t make any sense.
lines.zh: : 不，我就是没听懂。这完全说不通。

lines.en: : Oooookay, then I’ll be as blunt as I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 好——吧，那我就说得再直白不过了。

lines.en: : I’m in love with your dad, and I want to move in so I can become your new mom. Which isn’t to say I think I can ever replace your real mom. That’s absolutely not what I’m trying to do.
lines.zh: : 我爱上了你爸爸，我想搬进来，是为了能当你的新妈妈。这不是说我觉得自己能取代你亲生妈妈。我绝对没有这个意思。

lines.en: : But I love you, and I want to be here for both of you. I want this to be my life now. And if I can’t balance that with work, I will quit. This is what’s most important to me.
lines.zh: : 可我爱你，我想守在你们两个身边。我想让这成为我今后的人生。要是没法跟工作兼顾，我就退出。这才是我最看重的东西。

lines.en: : Maybe you should have some coffee too, Niki? You’re acting kinda crazy.
lines.zh: : 也许你也该喝点咖啡，Niki？你现在的样子有点疯。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom19
: Should we maybe try again some other time?...I’m not sure if this is going to work...
lines.zh: : 我们要不要改天再谈？……我不确定这样行不行……

lines.en: : No, we shouldn’t try again some other time. She needs to get it now or she’s just going to give us this same runaround every single time we try because she knows it’ll work.
lines.zh: : 不，不该改天再谈。她必须现在就弄明白，否则以后每次我们开口，她都会照样跟我们绕圈子——因为她知道这招管用。

lines.en: : Ami, I know you don’t approve of me being with your dad, but that’s not up to you. He can make his own decisions.
lines.zh: : Ami，我知道你不同意我和你爸爸在一起，但这不是你说了算的。他可以自己做决定。

lines.en: : If he can make his own decisions, why do you keep talking over him? Why aren’t you just making coffee right now?
lines.zh: : 既然他能自己做决定，那你为什么一直抢他的话？你为什么不干脆现在就去煮咖啡？

lines.en: scene livingintheroom20
: I’m not talking over him. In fact, if we were to toss somebody out of this conversation, which we shouldn’t since that not what families do, it would be him. This is about you and me, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我没有抢他的话。事实上，如果我们非要把谁从这场对话里踢出去——虽然我们不该这么做，因为家人不会这么做——那也会是他。这是我和你之间的事，不是吗？

lines.en: : He’s already approved of this. But you’re the one who needs to approve of it next since we all have to be involved. Which is why I have to figure out a way to get through to you.
lines.zh: : 他已经同意了。可下一个需要同意的人是你，因为我们所有人都得参与进来。所以我才要想办法让你听进去。

lines.en: : So what’s the main problem? Is it that I’m in love with him? Is it that you think I’m trying to be the next Sekai? Is it that you’re afraid you guys won’t get any alone time together anymore? What is it?
lines.zh: : 那么主要的问题是什么？是我爱上了他？是你觉得我想当下一个 Sekai？还是你怕你们俩从此再也挤不出独处的时间？到底是哪个？

lines.en: scene livingintheroom21
: All of the above.
lines.zh: : 以上都是。

lines.en: : It’s all of the above, obviously.
lines.zh: : 当然是以上全部。

lines.en: : Weekends are one thing, but I don’t know how to be a part of an actual family. I haven’t done that since I was a little kid. Let alone with someone who doesn’t even share my blood.
lines.zh: : 周末是一回事，可我不知道该怎么成为一个真正的家的一分子。我从记事起就没再经历过那种生活。更别说跟一个跟我毫无血缘的人了。

lines.en: : And it would really suck to hear them going at it all the time, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 而且天天听见他们两个干那档事，也太糟了吧？

lines.en: : Plus, if I have to hear you two having sex every night, I’m probably just going to off myself.
lines.zh: : 再说了，要是我每晚都得听你们俩做爱，我大概会直接把自己了结了。

lines.en: : Unless they let you join in.
lines.zh: : 除非他们让你加入。

lines.en: : Unless you let me get in on it, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，除非你们让我也掺一脚。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom22
: Ami! This isn’t something we should be joking about right now!
lines.zh: : Ami！这种事现在不该拿来开玩笑！

lines.en: : Who said I’m joking? I’m not joking. I’m super serious. I think that sounds fun, actually.
lines.zh: : 谁说我开玩笑了？我没开玩笑。我是超级认真的。说实话，我觉得那听起来挺好玩的。

lines.en: : Ami, no one said anything about sex. The thought hasn’t even crossed my mind.
lines.zh: : Ami，没人提过性。我连想都没想过。

lines.en: : Wow, what’s that like?
lines.zh: : 哇，那是什么感觉？

lines.en: scene livingintheroom23
: Normal. What matters most to me is making both of you happy. And if you’re 10000%% sure you can do that without me, okay. We can leave it at that and I’ll give up for now.
lines.zh: : 很正常。对我来说最重要的，是让你们两个都幸福。如果你 10000%% 确定没有我也能做到，那好吧。这事就到此为止，我暂时放弃。

lines.en: : But there are going to be more moments than you can even count where you’ll wish you had someone like me to share them with.
lines.zh: : 但往后会数不清地出现这样的时刻——你会希望身边有个像我这样的人，能跟你一起分担。

lines.en: : I have Sen- Dad. That’s plenty.
lines.zh: : 我有 Sen——爸爸。这就够了。

lines.en: : But he’s not going to paint your nails. He’s not going to have spa days with you or play dress-up with you or even understand you because he’s just a stupid boy.
lines.zh: : 可他不会给你涂指甲油。不会陪你做 spa，不会陪你玩换装游戏，甚至连理解你都做不到——因为他只是个蠢男孩。

lines.en: : And yeah, some boys would be great at that. There are millions of single fathers out there who can do everything for their daughters. But he isn’t one of them.
lines.zh: : 是啊，有些男孩很擅长这些。外面有成千上万的单亲爸爸，能为女儿做到一切。可他不是那种人。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom24
: And that’s okay...
lines.zh: : 这也没关系……

lines.en: : Not everybody has to be strong. There’s no problem asking for help. And it’s not like your dad chose this life.
lines.zh: : 不是每个人都得坚强。开口求助不是什么丢人的事。而且你爸爸也不是自己选了这样的人生。

lines.en: : He’s doing all he can and he loves you very much...
lines.zh: : 他已经尽力了，而且他很爱你……

lines.en: scene livingintheroom25
: But he needs help, Ami. He can’t do this alone. Which is why I volunteered to step in and become a part of this family if you’ll let me.
lines.zh: : 可他需要帮助，Ami。他一个人扛不下来。所以你若愿意，我自愿站出来，成为这个家的一分子。

lines.en: : The two of you have been through so much. More than anyone should ever have to. And I get that that’s why you’re so adamant about continuing this way since you’ve already come so far.
lines.zh: : 你们俩经历过太多。多得不该由任何人来承受。我明白，正因为你们已经走了这么远，你才会这么固执地想继续这样下去。

lines.en: : But it’ll always be easier to eat cereal with a spoon than a fork.
lines.zh: : 但吃麦片，用勺子永远比用叉子容易。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene livingintheroom26
: It’s a dumb analogy my mom used to say to me when I was little since I’m just as stubborn as you two.
lines.zh: : 这是我妈以前常对我说的一个蠢比喻，因为我跟你们两个一样犟。

lines.en: : Just because you can do things the harder way doesn’t mean you should. Things are so much easier if you just use the right tools.
lines.zh: : 能用更费劲的方式做事，不代表你就该那么做。只要用对工具，事情会轻松得多。

lines.en: : Ami Arakawa, let me be your spoon.
lines.zh: : Ami Arakawa，让我当你的勺子吧。

lines.en: : Yes, I am aware of how dumb that sounds.
lines.zh: : 是的，我知道这话听着有多蠢。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom27
: Dad...do you really think you need help?...
lines.zh: : 爸爸……你真的觉得自己需要帮助吗？……

lines.en: : Are you actually struggling that much?...
lines.zh: : 你真的已经撑得那么辛苦了吗？……

lines.en: : I need help, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我需要帮助，Ami。

lines.en: : I can’t figure all of this out on my own.
lines.zh: : 这些事我一个人想不明白。

lines.en: : And I think Niki is the missing piece of our puzzle.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得 Niki 就是我们这幅拼图缺的那一块。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : Inviting her into our home...
lines.zh: : 请她进我们家……

lines.en: : Do you really understand what that means?...
lines.zh: : 你真的明白那意味着什么吗？……

lines.en: : She already told you...she isn’t trying to replace anyone.
lines.zh: : 她已经说过了……她没想取代任何人。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom28
: She’s just an idiot who loves us for no discernible reason.
lines.zh: : 她只是个傻瓜，莫名其妙地爱着我们。

lines.en: : Yeah...there are a million other families you’d be better suited for. What makes us so special? Why choose this home to be a part of?
lines.zh: : 是啊……世界上还有一百万个更适合你的家庭。我们有什么特别的？为什么偏偏要选这个家？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Boredom, I guess?
lines.zh: : 不知道。大概是无聊吧？

lines.en: : Boredom?...
scene livingintheroom29
: I’m joking, dummy.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的，笨蛋。

lines.en: : I don’t have a good reason. That’s just kind of the way things played out, so maybe I am an idiot.
lines.zh: : 我没有什麼像样的理由。事情就这么自然而然地走到这一步了，所以也许我确实是个傻瓜。

lines.en: : All I know is that I wouldn’t trade either one of you for the world. And that our potential for happiness is way greater if we just merge families.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，给我全世界我也不会换走你们任何一个。而且只要我们两家并成一家，我们幸福的可能性会大得多。

lines.en: : Which would mean you’d have to inherit Noriko as well. And if that’s the deal-breaker, I totally get it. But hey, at least I tried.
lines.zh: : 当然，这也意味着你得连 Noriko 一起继承。如果这是让你没法接受的条件，我完全理解。不过嘿，至少我努力过了。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom30
: Niki...can I ask you one more thing?
lines.zh: : Niki……我还能再问你一件事吗？

lines.en: : You can ask me anything at any time. That’s the relationship I want to have with you.
lines.zh: : 你随时可以问我任何事。这就是我想和你建立的关系。

lines.en: : Just...this one thing is fine for now.
lines.zh: : 就……现在只问这一件就好。

lines.en: : Then, sure. Shoot.
lines.zh: : 那好，说吧。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom31
: You already know, but...I went a little crazy a while ago and...I accidentally hurt Dad...
lines.zh: : 你已经知道了，不过……前阵子我有点失控，然后……我不小心伤到了爸爸……

lines.en: : And I’ve been...really hard on myself ever since then because...it never even occurred to me that I could harm the person I love the most...
lines.zh: : 自那以后，我一直……对自己很苛刻，因为……我从来没想过，我居然会伤害到我最爱的人……

lines.en: : Now I’m...constantly afraid that something like that might happen again and...it’s really scary...not being able to trust even myself, so I...
lines.zh: : 现在我……总是害怕那样的事会再发生，而且……真的很可怕……连自己都信不过，所以我……

lines.en: : I wanna know, like...
lines.zh: : 我想知道，就是……

lines.en: scene livingintheroom32
: Would you still love me if...something like that ever happened to you?
lines.zh: : 如果……那样的事发生在你身上，你还会爱我吗？

lines.en: : I can assure you that a lifetime worth of fawning over your father has inflicted more damage on me than anything you could possibly do. I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，这辈子对你爸爸的百般讨好，给我造成的伤害远比你所能做的任何事都多。我不会有事。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But now I’m having second thoughts about this and-
lines.zh: : 好吧，当然。不过现在我又开始犹豫了——

lines.en: scene livingintheroom33
: Talk to the hand, Akira. We’re having a moment over here.
lines.zh: : 别插嘴，Akira。我们这边正温情着呢。

lines.en: : Ami, I am not going to love you any less for having an emotional breakdown. I had plenty of those when I was your age as well.
lines.zh: : Ami，我不会因为你情绪崩溃就少爱你一分。我在你这个年纪时，也崩溃过好多次。

lines.en: : And while my circumstances were entirely different from yours, I’ll still do my best to try and understand. That’s the ultimate goal here.
lines.zh: : 虽然我的处境和你完全不同，我还是会尽最大努力去理解。这才是这里的终极目标。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom34
: So...what do you say, kid? Want to give it a shot?
lines.zh: : 那么……怎么说呢，小家伙？要不要试试看？

lines.en: : Or am I going to have to return these pajamas?
lines.zh: : 还是说，我得把这套睡衣退回去？

lines.en: : Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll try using a spoon from now on.
lines.zh: : 那我从现在开始试着用勺子吧。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom35
Ami heads to her room to have a moment to herself, and Niki wastes no time at all in skipping over to me and aggressively shaking my shoulder in triumphant victory.
lines.zh: Ami 回自己房间去独处一会儿，Niki 一刻也没耽搁，蹦过来抓住我的肩膀猛摇，一副大获全胜的得意样。

lines.en: : And that is how it’s done, loser. The beating heart of Kumon-mi strikes again.
lines.zh: : 事情就该这么办，输家。Kumon-mi 那颗跳动的心脏再次出击。

lines.en: : I wasn’t really competing with you, you know. I wanted you to have success there.
lines.zh: : 我其实没在跟你比，你知道吗。我是希望你能拿下这件事。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom36
: And what a resounding victory it was!
lines.zh: : 而这是一场多么辉煌的胜利！

lines.en: : Ami gets a mom, I get a house, and you get to spend even more time with a girl so far out of your league that it’s almost criminal.
lines.zh: : Ami 得了个妈妈，我得了个家，而你则能和远远配不上你的姑娘待上更多时间——那简直算犯罪了。

lines.en: scene livingintheroom37
: I guess Noriko gets kind of shafted, though. Just not the good kind of shafted. That’s what you’re going to do to me later since I did such a good job today.
lines.zh: : 不过 Noriko 大概有点被亏待了。就是不是那种「好的亏待」。那是我今天干得这么漂亮，你待会儿要对我做的事。

lines.en: : Quiet, Niki. The walls are thin. Ami might hear you.
lines.zh: : 小声点，Niki。墙很薄。Ami 可能会听见。

lines.en: : Hm? Oh, I’ll call my sound-proofing guy later then. When should I start moving my stuff in? It’s like 90%% clothes. That shouldn’t be a problem since you only have one outfit in your closet, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦，那我待会儿给我的隔音师傅打电话。我什么时候开始搬东西进来？大概 90%% 都是衣服。应该不成问题吧，反正你衣柜里就那一身行头，对吧？

lines.en: : We’ll figure that out later. I want coffee.
lines.zh: : 那个以后再说。我要喝咖啡。

lines.en: : Ooooh, me too. It’s exhausting having so many feelings so early in the morning. But you probably wouldn’t know that as a robot.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，我也要。一大清早有这么多的情绪，真累人。不过你大概不懂，谁让你是机器人呢。

lines.en: : This robot is effectively your husband now.
lines.zh: : 这个机器人现在名义上是你丈夫了。

lines.en: : Beep-boop. Initiate hug protocol.
lines.zh: : 哔——啵。启动拥抱程序。

lines.en: : I’m going to live in hell from now on, aren’t I?...
lines.zh: : 我从今往后要活在地狱里了，是吧？……

lines.en: scene livingintheroom38
: Heh.
scene black
$ nikispring3 = True
$ niki_love += 1
Niki’s affection has increased to [niki_love]!
lines.zh: Niki 的好感度提升到了 [niki_love]!
